paper.title_en: A Survey on Symbolic Summation in Difference Rings
paper.abstract_en:
This survey article provides an overview of the fundamen-
tal principles used to simplify multi-sums into indefinite nested sums
over hypergeometric products in the setting of difference rings. We place
special emphasis on the algorithmic translation between hypergeometric
sums and the formal difference ring setting. Furthermore, we detail the
core summation paradigms of telescoping, creative telescoping, and re-
currence solving within difference rings, illustrating these techniques and
their underlying algorithms with concrete examples.
Keywords: Difference ring · telescoping · creative telescoping · param-
